description: This file defines the Error package for exception handling in Perl, including classes Error, Error::Simple, and Error::subs, with methods for error creation, propagation, and handling, as well as error stack trace and object association.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects, providing methods for error information, stack trace, object association, and error throwing.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error for simple string-based errors with optional value.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides exception handling syntax with try, catch, finally, except, otherwise.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Handles warning and die signals to generate stack traces and error messages.

methods.name: Error::new
methods.description: Constructs a new Error object, capturing caller info and optional stack trace.

methods.name: Error::throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, causing it to be caught or terminate the program.

methods.name: Error::with
methods.description: Creates a new Error object for syntactic sugar, e.g., die with Error.

methods.name: Error::record
methods.description: Creates and returns an Error object for recording errors without throwing.

methods.name: Error::prior
methods.description: Returns the last error created or associated with a package.

methods.name: Error::flush
methods.description: Clears the last error stored, either globally or for a package.

methods.name: Error::stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace if debugging is enabled, or a brief error message.

methods.name: Error::associate
methods.description: Associates an error with an object for error propagation.

methods.name: Error::stringify
methods.description: String representation of the error, typically the error text.

methods.name: Error::value
methods.description: Returns an associated value with the error, e.g., error code.
